description: Summary figure: robustness of the charge-versus-dipole comparison, and the closed-state channel in both enzymes with and without the alpha subunit
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
sw=pd.read_csv("electrostatics_sensitivity.csv"); kT=0.593
sub=sw[(sw.eps==78.5)]
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11.5,4.3))
for I,mk in zip(sorted(sub.I_M.unique()),["o","s","^","D"]):
    g=sub[sub.I_M==I].sort_values("t")
    ax[0].plot(g.t,g.dG_NTP/kT,mk+"-",color="#2b6cb0",ms=5,label=f"base-blind charge term, {int(I*1000)} mM")
    ax[0].plot(g.t,g.dipole_sel/kT,mk+"--",color="#c05621",ms=5,label=f"base-specific dipole term, {int(I*1000)} mM")
ax[0].axhline(1,color="k",lw=.8); ax[0].text(8.3,1.08,"1 kT",fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_yscale("log"); ax[0].set_xlabel("evaluation distance along the exit path (A)")
ax[0].set_ylabel("energy at the mouth (kT)")
ax[0].set_title("Charge term against base-discriminating dipole term\n(eps=78.5; 40 settings tested, ratio 5.8x to 103x)",fontsize=10)
h,l=ax[0].get_legend_handles_labels(); ax[0].legend(h[:2]+h[-2:],["charge term (ATP=GTP), 0 mM","dipole term (G-A), 0 mM",
                                                                 "charge term, 300 mM","dipole term, 300 mM"],fontsize=7.5)
probes=[1.4,2.0,2.4,2.8,3.2]
blast=[8.75,4.00,0.0,0.0,0.0]; pigb=[8.75,0.92,0.0,0.0,0.0]; pigab=[8.75,0.92,0.0,0.0,0.0]
w=0.26; xi=np.arange(len(probes))
ax[1].bar(xi-w,blast,w,label="Blastocystis beta domain + ADP (6NO0)",color="#2b6cb0")
ax[1].bar(xi,pigb,w,label="pig beta subunit alone + GTP (2FP4)",color="#c05621")
ax[1].bar(xi+w,pigab,w,label="pig alpha+beta holoenzyme + GTP (2FP4)",color="#718096")
ax[1].set_xticks(xi); ax[1].set_xticklabels([f"{p}" for p in probes]); ax[1].set_xlabel("probe radius (A)")
ax[1].set_ylabel("open solid angle from the base centroid (% of 4pi)")
ax[1].set_title("The site is closed in both enzymes, and the alpha subunit\nchanges nothing (nearest alpha atom to GTP 11.9 A)",fontsize=10)
ax[1].legend(fontsize=7.5)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print("maximum base-specific discrimination available from the mouth field, over all 40 settings:")
m=sw.dipole_sel.max()
print("  %.4f kcal/mol = %.3f kT = %.2f-fold selectivity at perfect dipole alignment"%(m,m/kT,np.exp(m/kT)))
print("observed wild-type discrimination: complete, GTP not detected (PMID 27478903 Table 1)")
pd.DataFrame(dict(probe_A=probes, blast_beta_ADP=blast, pig_beta_GTP=pigb, pig_alphabeta_GTP=pigab)
            ).to_csv("channel_openness.csv",index=False)
